title: skills/docs: teach the lookupFilters { $record } reference and orEmpty (relationships.mdx, fields.mdx, field-types.md)
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQjrEpxMVxEiDUJHqC

Follow-up from PR #34078 (card #34009, merged as `aab8b318`). That PR declared the `lookupFilters` value shape `{ $record: '<path>' }` (a reference to the record being edited), and the `orEmpty` flag, which pairs only with the six equality and ordering operators. Both are marked `[PLANNED — not enforced]` until their readers land (seat ruling 6900252552 §3).

**Ask (skills lane).** Once the ui picker card lands, so that the docs describe a working reader, update these three:
- `content/docs/data-modeling/relationships.mdx`
- `content/docs/data-modeling/fields.mdx`
- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md`

Cover four things: the reference shape, the empty-value rule (the entry is dropped), `orEmpty` and the six operators it pairs with, and `dependsOn` vs `$record`. Until then, the PLANNED markers are the truth.

Blocked-by: #34197
